[[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] '''Fez Kawakal''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorande]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Dorande (species)|Dorande]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was involved in a plot to invade [[R-Duba]]. The scheme was foiled, however, by a team consisting of R-Duba's [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Jagoda]], [[Kirk Windjammer]], and the trusty droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
